name: flare-status
description: Lets a Flare tab show what this Claude Code session is doing: working, waiting on you, finished or failed. Each hook prints one fixed terminal sequence; nothing leaves the PC. Also gives Claude tools to show an image, a file or some text in a panel beside the tab and to use Flare's browser panel, through Flare's own local control channel, a /browser command that opens a page there for you to browse, and a prompt hook that tells Claude which page that panel shows.
